idea: long when price below open and price below bb_lower30x0.8
name: Noro accuracy long (rule 1)
note: Buy a red candle that closes unusually far below its 30-bar average, betting on a snap back.  SIMPLIFIED: The script's average absolute distance from the 30-bar SMA over 1000 bars is replaced by a Bollinger lower band (30 bars, 0.8 stdev), because the grammar has no abs-distance average and lengths max out at 400; This band also covers the 'close below SMA(30)' condition; The accuracy multiplier is fixed at 1

idea: short when price above open

note: Short on every green or flat candle, the script's reversal side.  SIMPLIFIED: The script's close >= open is expressed as close above open, so flat candles are missed; The script reverses to short with a quantity of 0 and the short is meant partly as an exit, here it is treated as an independent entry

idea: long when price cross_above highest15[1] and price above ema150
name: ORION box breakout long (rule 1)
note: Buys a close above a tight, flat 15-bar range when price is above the 150 EMA.  SIMPLIFIED: Box setup (range height under 2.5 ATR and flat linear-regression slope) is not stated, so any 15-bar high breakout counts; Breakout level is the prior 15-bar high on the breakout bar, not the range frozen when the box formed; Box expiry after 45 bars and the 5-bar cooldown are dropped; Session filter 06:00-23:00 and Friday-late block are dropped; Stop at the opposite box edge and 1.9R target are replaced with a fixed 2.0 ATR stop and 3.8 ATR target (about 1.9R)

idea: short when price cross_below lowest15[1] and price below ema150
name: ORION box breakout short (rule 2)
note: Sells a close below a tight, flat 15-bar range when price is below the 150 EMA.
